name: False Death (Kobold Press/Open Design)
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level alchemist 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 min./level; see text

DESCRIPTION

When you drink this extract, you prepare your body for the likelihood of imminent harm. If you are dropped to negative hp but are not killed instantly, you appear to all outside observers to die. Your body becomes pale and cold, your eyes glaze over, you become insensitive to pain and injury and your heartbeat and breathing become undetectable.

While you appear dead, though, you remain aware of your surroundings,and you’re stabilized and gain fast healing 3 for 1 round per caster level-as long as you remain unmoving. If you move, stand, or take any actions-or when this extract’s duration ends-the extract ends and you may move and act as normal.
